registryAssessment: Nampula municipal regulation establishes a Municipal Urbanization and Cadastre Service responsible for maintaining cadastral records, administering the municipal-land cadastre, issuing cadastral certificates and organizing map/survey archives. This is local cadastral evidence, not a public title registry or anonymous GIS.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Municipal Internal Regulation Arts.59–62 establishes Urbanization and Cadastre Service; it maintains cadastral/municipal land records and issues certificates.
Municipal Council page lists Urbanization and Land Management.
National geospatial agency advertises MOZGIS; no Nampula parcel layer/schema documented in inspected sources.
Government layer named Nampula is an administrative polygon with field adm3_pt, not a parcel layer; excluded from geometry evidence.
